szoveg_eredeti:
We worked with the PyTorch team at Meta to bring Praxis-1 to ExecuTorch with NVIDIA TensorRT. Our open-weight world action model for robotics now runs up to 1.7x faster than our reference code on H100 and A100 GPUs with similar accuracy.

Learn more: https://lnkd.in/eN2Sydp2
